strong:
Each PA-TNC message may
contain zero or more attributes associated with the functional
component identified in the component type (PA Subtype) of the
Posture Broker (PB) protocol.

[...]

   A PA-TNC message MUST contain a PA-TNC header (defined in section
   3.6.  followed by a sequence of zero or more PA-TNC attributes.  All
   PA-TNC attributes MUST begin with a standard PA-TNC attribute header,
weak:
Each PA-TNC message may
contain one or more attributes associated with the functional
component identified in the component type (PA Subtype) of the
Posture Broker (PB) protocol.

[...]

   A PA-TNC message MUST contain a PA-TNC header (defined in section
   3.6.  followed by a sequence of zero or more PA-TNC attributes.  All
   PA-TNC attributes MUST begin with a standard PA-TNC attribute header,
held_constant: Section 4's statement; Section 3.1 differs in one word.
notes: Assembled from two verbatim passages of the same RFC, joined by [...]: the weaker document says 'one or more' in one section and 'zero or more' in the other.

weak.locator: RFC 5792 Section 3.1 as published, then Section 4

strong.locator: RFC 5792 Section 3.1 as corrected, then Section 4
